prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return Solution.java containing public final class Solution.
Required API: public static List<Integer> collapseRuns(List<Integer> values)
Behavior: Return one value for each maximal adjacent run. Preserve order, do not mutate input, and return a non-null empty collection for empty input.
Visible example: [2,2,1,1,2] becomes [2,1,2].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

import java.util.*;
public final class Solution { public static List<Integer> collapseRuns(List<Integer> v){var out=new ArrayList<Integer>();for(int x:v)if(out.isEmpty()||out.get(out.size()-1)!=x)out.add(x);return out;} }
